quality_policy.description: Class-wise raw/refined geometric-topological trajectories plus occlusion-aware flow IoU.
quality_policy.hard_anomaly: At least two independent evidence groups exceed robust class/video thresholds.
limitations: Temporal consistency cannot detect a semantically wrong mask that remains stable.
Optical flow is ignored where forward/backward consistency or class coverage is insufficient.
Thresholds are robustly estimated per class and video but require ground-truth calibration for formal guarantees.
